Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BITM Junior Mentor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for BITM Junior Mentor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Mentor post at Birla Industrial and Technological Museum is scheduled for 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Mentor position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior Mentor position, candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Science or a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a first-class distinction.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Mentor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Mentor position at BITM is 30 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Mentor role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Mentor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the BITM Junior Mentor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Mentor post?
faq.answer: Birla Industrial and Technological Museum is recruiting for a total of 5 vacancies for the Junior Mentor position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies. Duly filled application forms and passport-size photographs may also be required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Mentor position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Mentor post will be based on a Walk-in Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Birla Industrial and Technological Museum located?
faq.answer: The Birla Industrial and Technological Museum is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with the pincode 700019.
